summary_en: The video presents a cooking show episode demonstrating how to make a grape cream blend beverage. A male chef in white and a female assistant prepare the drink by dissolving milk tea mix in hot water, muddling green grapes in a glass, adding ice and fresh milk, and pouring the mixture in layered stages.
